_comment: Workload shapes. Each is a realistic enterprise traffic pattern, not a synthetic vanity number. The isl/osl ratio is what decides whether prefill or decode dominates - and therefore whether Dynamo disaggregation can help you at all.

workloads.name: chat
workloads.desc: Interactive assistant. Decode-bound. TTFT is the SLO that matters.

workloads.name: rag
workloads.desc: Retrieval-augmented QA. Prefill-heavy - the classic disaggregation win.

workloads.name: summarize
workloads.desc: Long doc in, short answer out. Most prefill-dominant case.

workloads.name: agent
workloads.desc: Tool-calling loop: medium prompt, long structured output.

workloads.name: batch
workloads.desc: Offline classification. No latency SLO - pure throughput/cost.
